title: Van Dedem (Constantinople) to the Burger Agent M. van der Goes, No. XVIII, 26 Aug 1799 (DECODE R1895)

steps.what: Fetched the R1895 images with the DECODE cookie together with the 1788-93 Dedem records.
Compared R1895 with the 1788-93 code: 2-3-digit groups with superscript marks, a different (Croiset-style marked) system; P1 is an unrelated clear page signed Schimmelpenninck.

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): R1895 (1799) is in a marked system of 2-3-digit groups with superscript marks, not the 1788-93 homophonic word code of R2120/R2122/R2131, so it is its own entry (dedem1799); the 1788-93 letters stay in dedem1788.

outcome.method_basis: Identified as a different marked code from the 1788-93 Dedem code; not transcribed, and no key for it is on DECODE or known.

gaps.detail: a different marked code; no key on DECODE; not transcribed

outcome.notes: Status: in progress in NOTES.md (not transcribed).

prior.where: No decipherment on the record; DECODE lists it as non-decrypted.
